notes.text: Andreas Simou (GARP) told the owner he will put him on the programme to speak on 'Measuring energy risk' (listed as Vince Kaminski, Managing Director, Research, Enron N.A.). He suggested expanding the title to cover VaR, regulatory requirements and/or price volatility.
The owner told Andreas Simou he would be glad to speak at the GARP energy risk stream. He could cover point 1, 8 or 6, in that order of preference.
notes.quote: I would be glad to speak at the energy risk stream.

notes.text: The owner agreed to work with Mark Williams on a workshop, 'Setting up a credit risk function for energy companies'. He offered to send both Mark and Andreas a reprint of a paper on the topic that he co-authored.
notes.quote: I would be glad to work with him on "Setting up a credit risk function for energy companies."

notes.text: The owner said the second workshop topic, RAROC, is fuzzy and may need a 3-way conference call with Andreas Simou and Mark Williams.

Andreas Simou asked the owner and Mark Williams (MTWilliams@edisonmission.com, 617-912-6000) to devise the workshop programme for the brochure, or each send their half of the agenda, because he goes to press this week.

notes.text: Zimin Lu is organizing a meeting titled "Research Model for Power Prices" to discuss and recommend a unified standard Research model for power price modeling.
Zimin Lu stated that power price modeling is important for power option pricing, power plant valuation and outage insurance premium calculation.
Zimin Lu noted that Research has developed different power price modeling approaches over the years, and choosing among them is a balance between robustness and accuracy.
Zimin Lu stated that Research needs to set a standard for power price modeling.
